description: This file defines an abstract utility class named ImageWorker used for efficient image loading and caching in Android applications. It manages background processing, memory/disk caching, placeholder images, and fade-in transition effects when displaying bitmaps in ImageViews.

classes.name: AsyncDrawable
classes.description: A custom drawable used as a placeholder during image loading, holding a weak reference to the background task.

classes.name: BitmapWorkerTask
classes.description: An AsyncTask subclass performing background image processing and caching, then updating the ImageView.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image into an ImageView, utilizing cache if available, or starting background processing.

methods.name: setLoadingImage
methods.description: Sets a placeholder image to display while the actual image loads.

methods.name: addImageCache
methods.description: Associates an ImageCache with this ImageWorker for disk and memory caching.

methods.name: setImageFadeIn
methods.description: Enables or disables fade-in transition when setting loaded images.

methods.name: setExitTasksEarly
methods.description: Signals background tasks to exit early, useful during UI pauses or scroll events.

methods.name: processBitmap
methods.description: Abstract method to define how bitmaps are processed in the background; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: cancelWork
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing work attached to a specific ImageView.
